summary: Tested NowKart delivery address regression fixes. Backend: 45/45 tests pass including 5 new delivery address tests. Frontend: DeliverySelector is interactive, navigates to /profile for guests. Addresses screen shows 'Select Delivery Address' title in ?select=1 mode. CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: cartRepository.ts had a duplicate `export const cartRepository` declaration (old version without selectedAddress param) that would cause a TypeScript/Metro bundler error.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: cartRepository.ts had cartRepository declared TWICE (lines 10-51 new version, lines 59-84 old version without selectedAddress param). The duplicate old declaration was removed. This would have caused a Metro bundler error and broken the entire checkout flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both issues from the regression are fixed and verified: (1) DeliverySelector on home screen has onPress -> guest goes to /profile, authenticated goes to /addresses?select=1. (2) Addresses screen in select=1 mode shows 'Select Delivery Address' title with Deliver Here button. (3) checkout/address.tsx handleProceed re-calls prepareCheckout with selectedAddress. (4) Backend accepts all delivery* fields. Critical fix applied: cartRepository.ts duplicate declaration removed.
rca_of_issue: cartRepository.ts was accidentally committed with the full object declared twice — the first (lines 10-51) was the new version with selectedAddress support, the second (lines 59-84) was the old version without it. TypeScript/Metro would error 'Cannot redeclare block-scoped variable cartRepository'. Fixed by removing the stale second declaration.
